description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key whose owner has SpaceNexus Research (the Space Score history is a Research product). One company's daily Space Score readings for up to 365 days: score, rank, the change from the previous reading, large moves flagged, and why a reading moved where the stored inputs can say. The current score stays free in company_lookup.

company.description: Company name or profile slug, e.g. "Rocket Lab" or "rocket-lab".

name: space_score_history
title: Space Score history
